struck_codes.strike_rationale:
W11 D · CP-D0 · Owner ruling A17.16 ACCEPT (Message 317 STEP 2 item 1, 2026-08-27) verbatim scope-fragment: 'the model-output form comes off the refused list'. Model output form is now OFFERABLE via ModelFormOfferEnvelopeV0 carrying the INGREDIENTS-ONLY guarantee verbatim: 'provenance of ingredients: what went in, its standard, its licence — never provenance of assertions.' Owner reasoning verbatim: 'claiming provenance of assertions would be overclaiming something training structurally cannot support — a direct violation of the platform's own "measure, don't assert" doctrine. Provenance of ingredients is the honest ceiling... the training manifest already tracks exactly this.'

W11 D · CP-D6 · Owner Ruling scope-correction (2026-08-27): the strike is SCOPED to the MODEL FORM DOCTRINAL USE ONLY. Callers whose refusal was tied to the model form's off-menu status now dispatch via ModelFormOfferEnvelopeV0 with the specific stronger-claim discriminator, not a refusal. Non-model callable_skill/knowledge_artifact null-multiplier refusal path retains `form_not_offerable` per valid_reasons[0] — this was NOT covered by A17.16 ACCEPT (nothing in the ruling made non-model forms offerable) and their §6.3/§6.4 build is pending. CP-D0/CP-D1 v4 rebuild over-executed the strike; v5 restores the scope.
